## Quirks (These Are Features, Not Bugs!)

Every specimen ships with undocumented features. Familiarize yourself with these quirks to prevent unnecessary panic:

::: {.callout-note}
## 🤓 Quirk #1: The Hyperfixation Loop
When Chris discovers a new topic, hobby, game, or technical tool, expect 48-72 hours of intense data acquisition and spontaneous lecture delivery.

* **Recommended Response:** Nod, ask *"Fascinating, tell me more,"* and offer water.
:::

::: {.callout-warning}
## ⚠️ Quirk #2: Low Battery Warning Signs
When social or cognitive reserves fall below 15%, Chris may exhibit glazed eyes, monosyllabic replies (*"Yeah", "Cool", "Mmm"*), and an involuntary pull toward horizontal surfaces.

* **Emergency Procedure:** Do not attempt serious life discussions. Supply blanket and allow silent recharge.
:::

::: {.callout-tip}
## 💡 Quirk #3: Instant Joy Triggers
Certain simple inputs reliably generate immediate smiles and happiness points:

<!-- CHRIS: Insert 3 things that never fail to make your day -->
* `[ Favorite snack / treat ]`
* `[ Favorite kind of music or environment ]`
* `[ Favorite spontaneous activity ]`
:::
